scope: presentation-only control classification for major visible M02 controls

classifications.label: Approve
classifications.notes: Mutates localStorage inbox approval state via approveStep; success toast uses demoSuccess qualifier. No live backend approval orchestration.

classifications.label: Reject / Return for Correction
classifications.notes: Local reject/return pathway with reason modal; warn toasts retained. Browser-only persistence.

classifications.label: Reassign
classifications.notes: Updates owner and ownershipHistory in local demo store (single and bulk). Not a directory/workflow backend.

classifications.label: Export / Print
classifications.notes: ConfirmExportModal prepares a demonstration export audit trail only; toast states not downloaded. No durable export service.

classifications.label: Reminders (bulk send / snooze)
classifications.notes: Creates local notifications and snooze fields in browser storage. Email/SMS delivery remains simulated; domain notification delivery outside P1-B5.

classifications.label: Notification settings
classifications.notes: Persists NotificationSettings to localStorage. Chrome honesty only for GAP-068; durable notification preferences deferred.

classifications.label: Create action
classifications.notes: CreateActionWorkspace writes new InboxAction into local seed store. No durable workflow engine.

classifications.label: Reset demonstration seed
classifications.notes: QA/demo-gated resetActionsToSeed; restores browser local demonstration data only.

classifications.label: Open clinical source system
classifications.notes: Navigates to linked operational/source route when present, otherwise demo toast. Softened chrome: does not claim patient clinical record management; clinical SoR remains external.

classifications.label: Analytics panel / drill-down
classifications.notes: Client-side rollups over local inbox actions with drill-down selection. No durable aggregation service (outside durable-domain / P2).

classifications.label: Summary cards (approvals/exceptions/escalations/reminders)
classifications.notes: Attributed as demonstration/local totals with period/source note; filter UX only.

classifications.label: Email / SMS delivery
classifications.notes: Banner states delivery is simulated. Live channel delivery not implemented under P1-B5.

classifications.label: Durable approval / notification orchestration
classifications.notes: OWN-P1-009 / P2 domain services. P1-B5 must not invent backend orchestration.

classifications.label: Patient clinical record management
classifications.notes: Excluded by patient/clinical boundary. Any source open is redirect/honesty only toward clinical source system.
